relations.subject: P. A. Payutto
relations.evidence: Payutto received a bachelor's degree in Buddhist studies from Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University in 1962.

relations.subject: P. A. Payutto
relations.evidence: After securing instructor qualifications, Payutto was appointed Associate Dean of Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University and had maintained this position for the following ten years.

relations.subject: P. A. Payutto
relations.evidence: 1995 Appointed to a post of Tipitaka Acharaya, as a scholar well versed in the Pali Canon, by Nava Nalanda Institute
